description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-069 (Create Sample Collection) where collectionStatus is not a recognized value. Same endpoint as API-069, isolated here to preserve the docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering.

body.collectionStatus: 'INVALID_STATUS' - not a valid collection_status value in this scenario

validation: collectionStatus must be one of COLLECTED, RECOLLECTION_REQUIRED, REJECTED (CHECK)

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-069 for the success contract

errors.condition: collectionStatus is not one of the allowed enum values

constraints: collection_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COLLECTED' CHECK IN (COLLECTED, RECOLLECTION_REQUIRED, REJECTED)
